sentences.text: Dated this the 05th day of December, 2025 The Criminal Miscellaneous Case is filed to quash Annexure-A1 First Information Report in Crime No.30/2022 registered by the Meenangadi Police Station, alleging the commission of the offence punishable under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submits that, the First Information Report in the above crime has been already been quashed by this Court as per its order dated 12.11.2025 in Crl.M.C.No.6980/2023.
In light of the above submission, the Crl.M.C is dismissed as infructuous.
